id.description: A unique integer value identifying this feature flag.

variant_key.description: The variant every user gets. Required for a multivariate flag and rejected for any other flag, because a release condition decides who the flag serves and not which variant they get.

version.description: The `version` from your most recent read of this flag. The change is refused with 409 if anyone else changed the flag after that version. A flag written before versioning reads as `null`; send that back unchanged and it is read as 0, so the value a read returns is always one this accepts.
